name: tape undo
author: LizardMan
description: Undo and redo the OP-1's own tape edits: a recording, lift, drop, split, join, a loop change. Part of Opus since beta 5, a row in the menu's system list with two settings, the steps kept on the OP-1 (up to 2) and with a flash drive in (up to 50); a push on its row opens the undo history (above). Delete an old tapeundo.opmod from the mods folder.
